rejectedAlternatives.reason: Forbidden fabrication. A sample of a database nobody has read is invented user data — the trial-1 failure. Labeled fixture records shaped like the exporter's output are legitimate test data; a fake notebook is not.

rejectedAlternatives.alternative: Keep the notes/links/tags schema guessed from Ideaflow's public documentation
rejectedAlternatives.reason: The real model is now readable and it is different: a typed property graph with no tag table (hashtags are content tokens and relations). Building against a guess when the truth is on disk would be a silent decision to misrepresent the data.

rejectedAlternatives.alternative: Accept schema drift from other branches (latest-main's contentText/relationCount/attributes, prod-push's attributes) by mapping those fields opportunistically
rejectedAlternatives.reason: Structural decision, defaulted-with-disclosure: the importer binds to the personal-dev-mew schema exactly; a record carrying drift fields is refused loudly, because which branch's schema the real export will carry is an open question for the owner, not a guess.

rejectedAlternatives.alternative: Deduplicate graph objects across versions by content similarity
rejectedAlternatives.reason: Structural decision, defaulted-with-disclosure: identity in Mew is (id, authorId) with a unique constraint; dedup is by id within one export, first occurrence kept, duplicates refused loudly. Similarity dedup can silently merge distinct objects, a silent drop wearing a cleanup label.

rejectedAlternatives.alternative: Migrate mew_user, notification, expansion_state and the legacy data table along with the graph
rejectedAlternatives.reason: Structural decision, defaulted-with-disclosure: whole-table drops, each counted in the manifest with a reason — identity stays in the auth domain (authorId strings are carried on every row), notifications are ephemeral, expansion state is UI state, dataTable is a legacy blob. Per-field, pk (storage surrogate) and content_tsvector (derived index) are dropped with recorded reasons; nothing is dropped silently.

openUnknowns: Notebook inventory: N graph nodes, M relations, relation-type and relation-list counts — awaiting owner input #1 (one exporter run); not estimated.

Which branch's schema the owner's real export will carry: personal-dev-mew (bound), latest-main (adds contentText/relationCount/attributes/canonical_path_cache), or prod-push (adds attributes + MCP settings). Drift refuses loudly until the owner decides.
Whether the harvested MewAgent acceptance cases should gate this migration slice (retrieval-only) or only the future CRUD-agent slice — an owner call recorded in the cases file per case.
Whether Convex deploy credentials exist for this machine; tested at LAUNCH, with a kill receipt if absent.
Hashtag semantics: hashtags live in node content and relations, not a table; whether the migration should materialize a derived hashtag index is deferred, not invented.
successCondition: On the owner's real export: the import manifest closes exactly per table (in = imported + refused, whole-table drops counted), every imported row carries sourceId + sourceDigest + importedAt, deterministic checks over the manifest pass, and the agent surface returns no answer without a source binding. Until that export exists, the same properties are demonstrated on labeled fixtures only and every data-dependent verdict stays NOT_RUN.
